posts.text: Aave has adopted Chainlink's 24/7 price feeds for its Horizon lending platform, so tokenised collateral such as heavily traded US equities can be valued at weekends and holidays when traditional exchanges are shut. Horizon runs as a separate, licensed instance where institutional borrowers pledge permissioned real-world assets against stablecoin liquidity from open pools. https:// crypto.news/aave-horizon-chain link-24-7-tokenized-stock-collateral/ # DAO # Web3 # DeFi
